card.name: Inside unit abbreviations after numbers
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a measurement unit written after a number, such as the tu in Btu, the grams in micrograms, Eq in mEq, Ci in mCi, or ft in Btu/ft2. It fires where the unit is split and not yet complete.

modes.label: Energy and area units
modes.description: Pieces of Btu/ft2 or cubic-foot units after a numeric value in technical text.
modes.example: mean heat flux of 0.43 B<<tu>>/ft2 per hour

modes.label: Medical dose units
modes.description: Second part of a split dose unit like micrograms, mEq or mCi after a number.
modes.example: a fall in serum bicarbonate to <20 m<<Eq>>/L in association with an alkaline urine
